title: The concept of state
competency: Explain what the term state means and appreciate Ethiopia as an old state.

keywords.def: An organized political community governed by a single authority.

en.text: A state is an organized political community governed by a single authority. Its people live permanently on a territory. They have their own government and are free from outside interference. States exist to settle disputes by law. There are over 200 states in the world.

screens.title: What is a state?
screens.ask: Hiwot reads the news. It says "the State of Ethiopia". What does "state" mean here?
opts: A region like Oromia or Amhara
The whole country, with its people, land and government
screens.after: Here "state" means the whole country: its people, land and government. Read on to find the full meaning.

screens.title: Introduction
paras: In Unit 1 you learned about good citizenship.
To use your rights and do your duties, you must understand the state and government.
This unit explains the state, its elements, and the forms of government.

screens.title: 2.1 The concept of state
paras: The term "State" refers to an organized political community governed by a single authority.
A state is a group of people who live permanently on a specific territory.
They have their own government, which most of the people obey.
They are free from outside interference.

screens.title: Why do we need a state?
paras: The state arises from the fundamental needs of life.
Its goal is to use laws to settle disputes between people.
Today over 200 states exist in the world.
screens.note: Remember: a State is a formally established political community that operates under the authority of a government.

screens.title: State or not?
items: A state: its own people, territory, government and sovereignty.
A state that borders Ethiopia to the south.
A regional state inside Ethiopia. It is not an independent state in this sense.
Not a state: it has no territory or sovereignty.

screens.title: Key words
defs: An organized political community governed by a single authority.

screens.text: Which is the best meaning of "state"?
opts: A group of friends with a leader
An organized political community governed by a single authority
A political party that wins an election
screens.ans: An organized political community governed by a single authority
screens.why: That is the book's definition of a state.
screens.clue: Look at the first sentence of 2.1.

screens.text: Why do we need a state?
opts: To use laws to settle disputes between people
screens.ans: To use laws to settle disputes between people
screens.why: The goal of a state is to use laws to settle disputes between and among individuals.
screens.clue: Read "Why do we need a state?".

screens.text: About 20 states exist in the world today.
screens.why: The book says over 200 states exist in the world.
screens.clue: Look at the world map paragraph.

screens.ask: A state's people live permanently on a specific ___.
screens.why: A state is a group of people who live permanently on a specific territory.
screens.clue: Where do the people of a state live?

screens.text: A group has people, land and a leader. But another country controls all its decisions. Is it a full state?
opts: Yes, it has people and land
No, it is not free from outside interference
Yes, because it has a leader
No, because it is too small
screens.ans: No, it is not free from outside interference
screens.why: A state must be free from outside interference. Size does not matter.
screens.clue: Read the definition again: what must a state be free from?

items.text: Why do we need a State?
opts: Because it arises from the needs of life and settles disputes by law
Because every person wants a flag
Because the world has too many people
items.ans: Because it arises from the needs of life and settles disputes by law
items.why: The state arises from the fundamental needs of life. Its goal is to settle disputes by law.
items.clue: Read "Why do we need a state?".

items.text: What makes Ethiopia a unique state?
opts: It is one of the oldest states and kept its independence
items.ans: It is one of the oldest states and kept its independence
items.why: Ethiopia is one of the oldest states. Its heroes defended its sovereignty, so it kept its independence.

test.text: A state is an organized political community governed by a single ___.
test.why: That is the definition of a state.

test.text: The people of a state live on a specific territory.
test.why: A state is a group of people living permanently on a specific territory.

test.text: What is the goal of establishing a state?
test.why: The goal is to use laws to settle disputes between people.

test.text: A state must be free from outside interference.
test.why: The definition says a state is free from outside interference.

test.text: Which of these is a state in the sense of this unit?
test.why: Ethiopia has people, territory, government and sovereignty. The others do not.
